evidence.title: Screen Movie - Screen Recorder & Video Editor for macOS

name: Screen Movie
summary: macOS screen recorder and video editor that turns raw recordings into framed product demos with motion presets, auto zoom and 4K export.
description: A native macOS screen recorder, screenshot tool and video editor aimed at product demos and launch videos (macOS 15+). One timeline holds multiple scenes with text, images, captions and music; 40+ motion presets, smooth cursor motion, auto zoom that follows the cursor, ready-made and animated shader backgrounds, 3D device mockups and multi-camera recording. Exports up to 4K and shares one-click cloud links for feedback.
contains: native macOS screen recorder, screenshot tool and video editor; macOS 15+
one timeline for multiple scenes: text, images, captions, music
40+ motion presets, smooth cursor motion and auto zoom that follows the cursor
ready-made and animated shader backgrounds; 3D device mockups
